anomalies.observed: The EPD boost-converter MOSFET Q3 is listed with value MCH3478-TL-W, but its KiCad footprint and imported part/package are for MCH3478-TL-H in SC-70FL / MCPH-3 (3-pin, 0.65 mm pitch), not SOT-23.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the EPD boost switch is MCH3478-TL-W, N-channel MOSFET, SOT-23, 30 V/2 A, matching the Pervasive Displays reference BOM.

evidence.quote: Q1 | MCH3478-TL-W (N-channel MOSFET, SOT-23, 30 V/2 A) | EPD boost-converter switch

anomalies.impact: The intended SOT-23 part would not match the SC-70 footprint; if an SC-70 part is populated instead, package thermal/current characteristics may differ from the reference design, potentially affecting the EPD boost converter reliability.

parsed.summary: Most connectivity matches the specification, but the EPD boost MOSFET Q3 has a footprint/package mismatch: the netlist shows an SC-70FL/MCPH-3 footprint for MCH3478-TL-H while the intended design specifies MCH3478-TL-W in SOT-23.
